title: Proof queue: scalar integer comparisons
selection_note: Twenty-six pending source-local scalar comparison rewrites, selected for fixed-width bit-vector/algebra proofs. Each item records a flag-free specialization where LLVM ICmpProperties does not model samesign; source use-count and match guards are separated from the mathematical identity. The comparison source branch may admit additional flagged or analysis-dependent cases beyond the stated proof scope.

operand_permutations_and_match_shape: This branch needs no one-use guard. If the matcher reaches it after swapping compare operands, use the correspondingly swapped predicate; the listed form is the exact direct orientation.
required_constants_and_type: Scalar integer iN, iN >= 1; X and Y have identical type.
